title: Retail loan principal movement domain model (synthetic example)

entities.name: Party
entities.definition: A person or organization that holds or owes a synthetic account.
entities.grain: one row per party per effective period

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.definition: Date this party version becomes effective

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.definition: Date this party version ceases to be effective; blank while the version is current

entities.name: LoanAccount
entities.definition: An agreement under which synthetic principal is advanced and repaid.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.definition: Date the synthetic account was opened

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.definition: Currency of the synthetic balance and of this account's signed event amounts

attributes.name: segment
attributes.definition: Synthetic portfolio segment used for review prioritization; blank when unassigned

entities.name: LoanEvent
entities.definition: An immutable synthetic financial or lifecycle event on a loan account. Events carry a posting date (when recorded) and an effective date (the business date the movement applies to); movement analysis groups by the effective date.

attributes.name: loan_account_id
attributes.definition: Synthetic loan account the event belongs to

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.definition: Documented extract code list: DISBURSEMENT, PRINCIPAL_REPAYMENT, FEE, or REVERSAL

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.definition: Business date the event applies to

attributes.name: posted_date
attributes.definition: Date the event was recorded in the extract

attributes.name: event_amount
attributes.definition: Signed synthetic event amount: disbursements positive, principal repayments negative, reversal rows the negation of the reversed event

attributes.name: reversal_link_id
attributes.definition: event_id of the single original event this reversal negates; blank on non-reversal rows

relationships.definition: A party holds one or more synthetic loan accounts. Party versions are effective-dated: any join to party attributes must select the version effective at the analysis date (as-of join).
A loan account records one or more synthetic events.
Read from the original event to its reversal: an original event is reversed by at most one reversal event through reversal_link_id, and every reversal reverses exactly one original event.
